messages.subject: Could I participate in the project R-EM-Accelerator
parts:
HI all I am a Maths student new to here and wish to join in the R-EM-
Accelerator project by Mentor: Ravi Varadhan,

Is it still applicable? As I am pretty confused about the mentor's
proposal/ project ideas and student's proposals. Do I have to compose
a distinct proposal from all the existe d project idea? Or am I
allowed to be mentored in the existed projects?

Anyway, currently I am working on the tests of this R-EM-Accelerator
topic as I don't want to miss the chance. And will email the solution
with my personal details to Ravi Varadhan in 4 hours. Is it a correct
workflow?

You need to apply on the melange site no later than Friday.

Instructions may be found here:

http://google-opensource.blogspot.com/2011/03/student-applications-now-being-accepted.html

After the application period closes organizations and mentors will
evaluate the student proposals, and accepted proposals will be funded by
Google.
